SOLOIST deliberately raises one hand. CHORUS advances as one ordered body because of that gesture, turning a readable pose into a cue with a recipient. The sequence ends with the hand still raised and the rows at their authorized nearer endpoint, so the call has changed the shared ground but has not yet been held long enough to close the exchange.

The scene begins before either subject moves, lets the hand rise and the rows answer during the same event, and ends after both changes have settled. Its dramatic question is whether the gesture reaches a recipient; the ordered advance answers yes.
